description: This file defines arithmetic computation functions and macros for the FreeType project, including square root calculation, fixed-point conversions, and multiplication/division operations.

methods.name: FT_SqrtFixed
methods.description: Computes the fixed-point square root of a 32-bit integer.

methods.name: FT_Sqrt32
methods.description: Calculates the square root of an Int32 integer.

methods.name: FT_MulDiv_No_Round
methods.description: Performs a multiplication of two values and divides by a third without rounding, using 64-bit intermediate precision.
